objectives.description: Resolve citation_key to real Zotero item key via zotero-resolve-pdf.sh (unmodified, stdin JSON)
Discover PDF URL via Unpaywall DOI lookup on the resolved item's zotero_doi; honest stop if none
Call zotero-write.sh attach-file on the resolved key
Reuse Phase 4/5 machinery (ingest delegate, metadata patch, sub-index) for the attached document

approaches_tried.approach: Mock a local HTTP server on 127.0.0.1:23119 to simulate the Zotero live API for a full attach-path end-to-end test
approaches_tried.reason: A real Zotero instance is already running and bound to 127.0.0.1:23119 on this machine (discovered via a failed bind attempt, which returned real library data from the user's actual Zotero library). Abandoned to avoid any risk of touching real Zotero state; pivoted to a read-only real-API test of the honest tier=absent stop path only, plus code-level reuse verification for the rest (see plan Phase 6 verification-scope-note deviation).

deviations.description: Full live-API attach-path end-to-end test (resolve -> found existing item -> Unpaywall -> download -> attach -> ingest)
deviations.reason: A real Zotero instance already owns 127.0.0.1:23119 on this development machine; mocking or exercising the live API further risked touching the user's real Zotero library. Verified the honest tier=absent stop safely (read-only) against the real API with a fabricated non-matching title, and verified every downstream helper this path shares with the already-fully-tested create-item path (Phase 4/5) plus the attach-file command construction (Phase 1 stub-zot regression).
